purpose: Bond the exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 configured assembly directly to the UI PCB outer face with a die-cut PSA frame and mate its upward-facing tail through one serviceable 50-contact ZIF on the UI PCB inner face; neither the FPC nor ZIF carries panel load.

components.role: direct dual-contact 50-position ZIF for the exact 0.30-mm EastRising tail

mechanical_retention.panel_support: flat component-free UI PCB outer-face display bed reserved under the complete 56.54 x 84.96-mm configured panel outline
mechanical_retention.primary_retention: one 0.17-mm target die-cut perimeter PSA frame directly between the panel rear perimeter and the UI PCB outer soldermask
mechanical_retention.secondary_retention: none in the assembled stack; PCB assembly datums and a removable placement fixture control alignment without becoming retained parts
mechanical_retention.flex_strain_relief: controlled folded-tail corridor from the antenna edge to the direct ZIF; no tensile or peel load reaches the contacts or latch
mechanical_retention.service_rule: opening the sandwich exposes the ZIF latch; release the latch first, then warm and cut the PSA frame before lifting the panel, and install a fresh die-cut frame before reassembly

physical_realization.part_type: component-free region of the UI PCB outer face, not a separate purchased part
physical_realization.implementation: reserve the complete 56.54 x 84.96-mm configured panel projection as a flat soldermask-controlled landing area; the adhesive zone contains no components, vias, test points, copper-height steps or silkscreen, and placement datums remain outside the panel outline
physical_realization.load_role: supports the panel and transfers normal, touch and handling loads directly into the UI PCB

physical_realization.part_type: carrier-backed double-coated acrylic display-bonding tape, converter die-cut as a peelable frame
physical_realization.implementation: 0.17-mm target thickness; nominal 2.0-mm perimeter band on the documented safe rear perimeter, interrupted at the antenna-edge FPC exit; no liquid glue and no adhesive on the active glass, FPC or rear components
physical_realization.load_role: retains the panel against lift and in-plane shear and distributes touch load into the PCB bed
physical_realization.material_candidate_not_yet_selected: 3M 9495LE is a technically suitable 0.17-mm die-cuttable display-bonding candidate, but is not an accepted production MPN or JLCPCB placement route yet
physical_realization.release_gate: freeze the exact adhesive grade, converter cut drawing, cleaning/pressure/dwell process and written one-prototype assembler acceptance before order

physical_realization.part_type: PCB keep-out corridor plus optional removable low-tack polyimide assembly guide
physical_realization.implementation: controls bend radius and preserves service slack from the panel tail at board -Y to the antenna-edge ZIF; the guide is removed or left non-structural after insertion
physical_realization.load_role: prevents panel motion from becoming tensile or peel load at the ZIF contacts

mechanical_retention.structural_load_path: finger or handling load -> panel rear perimeter -> die-cut PSA frame -> UI PCB -> sandwich stops and fasteners; never through the FPC or ZIF

esp32_div_v2_reference.panel_mount: raw 2.8-inch display body seated directly on the main PCB
esp32_div_v2_reference.in_plane_location: four empty 1.2-mm holes surround the display zone on a 49.10 x 68.25-mm rectangle; the official Gerber drill file marks them plated, but the copper flashes are only drill-size and the assembled-device photograph shows that they do not locate or retain the display
esp32_div_v2_reference.electrical_connection: 18-contact display FPC soldered directly to eighteen 0.4 x 4.5-mm SMD lands; no display ZIF
esp32_div_v2_reference.not_publicly_documented: the published Gerbers, PcbDoc, BOM, 3D model and assembled-device photograph do not identify a positive display retainer; the BOM contains no frame, fastener, foam or adhesive line, so a hidden PSA bond is plausible but unproven
esp32_div_v2_reference.leshy2_adoption_rule: use DIV only as evidence that a raw panel can occupy a direct PCB seat; Leshy2 explicitly defines the otherwise undocumented adhesive bond, assembly controls and a serviceable non-load-bearing ZIF

electrical.signal_contract: the UI PCB routes every required panel power, ground, i8080-8, recovery and touch net directly to the exact 50-contact connector; manufacturer NC and SDO contacts remain open
electrical.recovery_mode: deliberate strap change to ILI9488 4-wire serial; no QSPI claim

recovery_straps.primary_population: i8080-8: pin 34 and TE pin 39 are open; pin 38 CS is strapped low; RD is strapped high; IM2/IM1/IM0 = 0/1/1
recovery_straps.serial_recovery: service-only solder-jumper population links panel SDA pin 34 to S3 LCD_DB7/GPIO46 and moves CS pin 38 from ground to S3 LCD_DB6/GPIO42; the mode-select jumpers are repopulated to the manufacturer 4-wire-serial code
recovery_straps.safety: all recovery pads are on the opened inner face and cannot change mode during normal use

electrical.h2_rule: H2 places this connector on the UI PCB and routes the accepted panel map directly; no display adapter PCB or board-to-board display connector is populated.

orientation.panel_rule: mount the configured panel with its folded FPC toward the antenna edge (board -Y) so the tail never enters the LED, navigation or function-key zone
orientation.factory_orientation_check: before pressing the PSA, the panel tail must exit toward the antenna edge and align with the direct ZIF corridor; any tail toward +Y is a stop-work assembly error
orientation.display_memory_transform: rotate ILI9488 output by 180 degrees relative to its cable-down native orientation
orientation.touch_transform: rotate FT6236 coordinates by 180 degrees before UI hit-testing
orientation.tail_contract: manufacturer drawing controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm-pitch, 0.30-mm-stiffened folded tail; H5 incoming inspection verifies lot conformity and insertion

evidence.finding: EastRising controls the 50-contact 0.50-mm tail, complete CTP outline, 8080-8 strap and every LCD/touch/backlight contact.
Exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 is orderable at quantity one with the ER-TPC035-6 capacitive-touch option.
FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) is exact HRS original-manufacturer C3169104, Extended SMT, Economic/Standard PCBA, MOQ 1 and verified live stock.

3M documents 9495LE as a 0.17-mm carrier-backed double-coated acrylic tape for die cutting and bonding metals, plastics and glass; it is only a technical candidate until an exact converter cut and assembler route are confirmed.

The official ESP32-DIV v2 Gerbers expose eighteen direct-solder FPC lands and four empty 1.2-mm holes around the display zone. The holes do not retain the assembled display, and the public PCB, BOM, 3D model and photograph do not establish the actual retention method; a hidden PSA bond remains an inference, not a documented fact.

release_boundary: H1 freezes the exact panel, component-free UI-PCB display bed, mandatory board -Y / antenna-edge FPC direction, direct C3169104 ZIF position, 50-contact electrical map and non-load-bearing connector rule. H2 imports the exact footprint and routes the display sheet directly on the UI PCB; before order H5 freezes the exact PSA grade/cut/process and obtains written factory acceptance for panel placement and FPC insertion; H7/H8 inspect the one assembled prototype.
